name: committed state and a stored None are distinct from deletion
input: set None, delete it, and inspect presence separately from get
test:
store = TransactionalKVStore()
store.set('color', 'blue')
assert store.get('color') == 'blue'
assert store.contains('color')
store.set('nullable', None)
assert store.get('nullable') is None
assert store.contains('nullable')
store.delete('nullable')
assert store.get('nullable') is None
assert not store.contains('nullable')

name: inner commits remain reversible by an outer rollback
input: outer writes, an inner commit, then the outer rollback
test:
store = TransactionalKVStore()
store.set('version', 1)
store.begin()
store.set('version', 2)
store.set('outer_only', 'yes')
store.begin()
store.set('version', 3)
store.set('child_only', 'yes')
store.commit()
assert store.get('version') == 3
assert store.contains('child_only')
store.rollback()
assert store.get('version') == 1
assert not store.contains('outer_only')
assert not store.contains('child_only')

name: nested deletes merge into parents and outer commit applies them
input: delete a parent-visible key in a child transaction
test:
store = TransactionalKVStore()
store.set('keep', 'value')
store.set('remove', 'value')
store.begin()
store.set('keep', 'new')
store.begin()
store.delete('keep')
store.delete('remove')
store.commit()
assert not store.contains('keep')
assert not store.contains('remove')
store.commit()
assert not store.contains('keep')
assert not store.contains('remove')
store.delete('already_missing')
assert not store.contains('already_missing')
